purpose: Restart the Chapter 1 trait-environment atlas from all 27 endpoints registered by the frozen GEB v2 continuous-trait contract and all nine frozen environmental predictors, without using the old nine-endpoint v1 result set as a selection rule.

trait_universe.selection_rule: Every registered endpoint is retained in the endpoint inventory. Every endpoint with a finite measurement_available value is modelled regardless of analysis_tier. Unexecuted endpoints remain explicit no-measurement rows.

environment.cohort: all 46276 phenotype-blind strict-spatial GEB v2 observations before endpoint missingness filtering
environment.gsp_definition: CHELSA climatic growing-season precipitation, not taxon-specific flowering-season precipitation
environment.npp_definition: CHELSA modelled potential net primary productivity, not measured local resource supply

within_taxon.linear_statistic: taxon-demeaned standardized univariate slope with taxon-clustered standard error
within_taxon.circular_statistic: joint sine-cosine standardized slope magnitude with predictor permutation within taxon

among_taxon.taxon_environment_summary: median across all strict-spatial observations for the taxon
among_taxon.permutation_rule: shuffle the predictor across the same taxa

multiplicity.families: one family across all successful trait units and all nine predictors, separately for within taxon, among min5 and among min2

spatial_sensitivity.entry_rule: rows with q_fdr_bh_global_family < 0.05 in the matching scale-specific atlas
spatial_sensitivity.method: refit with second-order spherical-coordinate basis; taxon-centred with taxon-clustered uncertainty within taxa and Freedman-Lane residual permutation among taxa
spatial_sensitivity.residual_diagnostic: eight-nearest-neighbour Moran I on at most 5000 deterministic observations
spatial_sensitivity.role: broad-space sensitivity for the new v2 full-environment lane, not equivalence to the older nine-endpoint SPDE analysis

historical_sensitivity.entry_rule: among-taxon rows surviving the new broad-space sensitivity
historical_sensitivity.tree_resource: audited GBOTB.extended.LCVP scenario 1, scenario 3 and 50 randomized scenario-2 placement trees
historical_sensitivity.method: univariate Pagel-lambda PGLS separately for the selected endpoint-gradient pair on every available placement tree
historical_sensitivity.role: historical-placement sensitivity only because most taxa are grafted and the tree does not resolve reticulate history

claim_boundary: This is a retrospective exploratory atlas because related GEB v2 outcomes were inspected before this full 27 by 9 analysis was declared.
A within-taxon cross-sectional association is not demonstrated plasticity, selection or adaptation.
An among-taxon permutation does not remove spatial or phylogenetic non-independence.
The nine environmental predictors are correlated observational gradients; a univariate slope does not identify an independent causal mechanism.
Validation-only surface endpoints remain image proxies until botanical reference measurements are available.
Unexecuted endpoints are missing evidence, not biological zero or trait absence.
